nom: Drunk Elephant A-Gloei Marula + Retinol Oil

segments.sensitive: Multiple reviewers with self-described sensitive skin (including brown skin) report no irritation, redness, or breakouts, and describe the retinol as unusually gentle for their skin type.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, very dry, or dry/combination skin report the oil is hydrating and helps with seasonal dryness without feeling greasy, though one used it mixed into body lotion instead of on the face.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination (including combination/sensitive/acne-prone) skin report a lighter-than-expected texture and fewer breakouts with regular use.
segments.mature: Reviewers who identify as mature or older (50s, aging skin) report smoother, firmer-looking skin and softened lines with continued use.
segments.oily: One reviewer feels the oil is greasy on her face and worries it clogs her pores, so she now only mixes small amounts into body lotion instead of using it facially.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report smoother texture, softened fine lines, and a firmer, more radiant look over weeks to months; one reviewer with no visible signs of aging says she cannot personally judge anti-aging effects, and another notes effects are gradual rather than dramatic.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers, including those with dry or very dry skin, describe the oil as hydrating, plumping, and non-drying, with some using it as their main nighttime moisturizer; one reviewer explicitly says it is not intended as a moisturizer despite the hydrating feel.
concerns.redness: Several sensitive-skin reviewers say the product does not trigger redness or blotchiness even at retinol strength; however, one reviewer reports her skin turned red, blotchy, and later white and flaky after use, requiring heavy moisturizer to recover.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers note the ceramides help rebuild or strengthen the skin barrier, especially after irritation, with no reported dryness or cracking; no dissent noted.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, sun spots, and hyperpigmentation within weeks to months; one reviewer used it for 8 weeks with no visible improvement in dark spots.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer breakouts, faster healing of blemishes, and reduced acne scars; one reviewer specifically credits it with clearing acne without drying her skin, while another with oily/clog-prone skin felt it worsened pore congestion.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers describe the oil as absorbing quickly and not leaving a greasy residue, but a few describe it sitting on the skin, feeling thick like Vaseline, or leaving an oily residue if used in the daytime.

extraits.texte: It irritates my skin :( I really wanted to like it. It makes my skin red and blotchy when I use it (it goes away, but that's disconcerting). I don't have sensitive skin when using other products, but my skin just doesn't like this guy! After my first week of using it (I mixed it with the B-Hydra Hydration Serum) - it made my skin white and flakey. I've been using heavy duty CeraVe cream for weeks just to get it back to normal. I DO love the Hydration Serum. But I guess my skin just doesn't like retinol.

Myself, I was not a huge fan of this product and I love everything Drunk Elephant. It is very greasy on my face and I feel like it clogs my pores. Since I had high expectations, I purchased a large bottle. I dont want to waste it so I add alittle to my body lotion and it does seem to help with summertime dryness.

Don't be turned off by the smell… this is a NATURAL product!!! If you want something smelling like flowers or candy, you will need to head to a product with synthetic ingredients and/or additives. If you are looking for a clean beauty product, give it a try. I have dry/combination skin that is ridiculously sensitive. I have breakouts when the seasons change, it's windy, too little moisture in my products/too much in the products, washing less than twice a day, cycle time, I'm outside, the sun is shining (not literally all those things, but you get the picture). My skin is temperamental and needs a product that can balance it out. Well, found it! I was skeptical about this product because it's an oil. I was surprised to find how well it absorbed into my skin leaving it soft and did not leave it greasy or cause any breakouts. I've been using it for about 3 months now and I have zero complaints. If you follow the directions and do 2-3 drops at night, you might enjoy the results. Always take a few minutes and massage it in! Our skin loves massages, and that too helps with the fine lines and wrinkles. I was told years ago by a dermatologist to allow skincare products at least 6 months to see full results. The only thing that works overnight is surgery, and even that has a healing time to see the final product, so if you try it, be patient with the process. Yes, it is pricey. Yes, I think DE is geared for mature skin. Yes, it's worth it.

This retinol oil is truly remarkable! Despite having sensitive, combination, and acne-prone skin, I've found it gentle enough for regular use without any breakouts. After just a few days of consistent application, I've noticed my skin tone evening out and a healthy glow overall. Plus, I'm experiencing fewer breakouts. I'm seriously impressed and will definitely repurchase when I finish this bottle. It's absolutely worth the investment. Offered by drunkelephant

I was gifted by drunk elephant. A nice gentle retinol I have been using for 2 weeks now about 3 times a week. Significantly better skin texture and lightening of my hyperpigmentation in my cheeks. I haven't had any sensitivity and I have dry skin so it hasn't affected my skin at all wear it dries it out more just a nice balance. I use this mainly at night as well.

extraits.titre: Ideal for mature and dry skin
extraits.texte: This facial oil is a gentle yet powerful retinol treatment, perfect for reducing blemishes and hyperpigmentation. While it's a bit heavier than expected, it pairs beautifully with my moisturizers. I've learned to apply it sparingly to avoid any heaviness. Ideal for mature and dry skin, like mine. complimentary from drunk elephant
One of the few retinols that doesn't irritate my sensitive skin!! I have no visible signs of aging, so can't speak to its anti-aging properties.
